defender.label: Defender exclusion for worktrees
defender.why: Agents create and delete many files in their worktrees, and real-time scanning of every file slows that down. This folder is not excluded:
defender.whyUnknown: Windows shows the exclusion list only to administrators, so Crewyard cannot tell whether this folder is already excluded. Agents create and delete many files here, and real-time scanning slows that down:
defender.step1: Open Windows Security, then Virus & threat protection, then Manage settings.
defender.step2: Under Exclusions, select Add or remove exclusions, then Add an exclusion, then Folder.
defender.orAdmin: Or run this in PowerShell opened as administrator:
defender.checkAdmin: To see the current list, run this in PowerShell opened as administrator:
defender.never: An exclusion is a gap in protection, so add it only if worktrees feel slow. Crewyard only reads these settings and never changes them.
